tanya: Kicking off canary roll for v3.2.0 at 14:07 UTC to pool-gamma. Request quick smoke + synth-coverage probe (kv-prefill, heartbeat, synth-coverage, embed-synth). @deploy-bot please run.

deploy-bot: started smoke-suite (canary-quick). probes: kv-prefill, http-heartbeat, synth-coverage, embed-synth. ETA ~3m.

leo: Quick acceptance rule: fail if synth-coverage drops below 92% OR embed-synth p95 > 225ms OR sustained 5xx >0.4% for >90s.

sre-oncall: initial telemetry: synth-coverage in eu-central degraded to 88% (missing some tokenization branches), embed-synth p95 in eu-central up to 235ms, 5xx ~0.6%. Marking region anomalous.

deploy-bot: smoke-suite summary:
- kv-prefill: OK (p95 39ms)
- http-heartbeat: OK
- synth-coverage: FAIL (eu-central 88% < 92%)
- embed-synth: ANOMALY (eu-central) p95=236ms, 5xx=0.6%
Canary pool status: PARTIAL_FAIL (eu-central).

tanya: Not a full-global failure. Options: 1) isolate eu-central and pin it back to v3.1.8, 2) throttle traffic to eu-central and continue, 3) rollback global. Prefer targeted isolation.

irma: Agree isolate. Pin eu-central to v3.1.8 and run extended synth-coverage sweep (10m) and tokenizer debug capture. Also add temporary alert for synth-coverage < 90% over 5m.

# commands
/pin inference --region eu-central --to-version v3.1.8 --reason "synth-coverage gap + embed tail"
/deploy rollback --region eu-central --to-version v3.1.8 --reason "targeted rollback: synth-coverage regression"


deploy-bot: Pin + targeted rollback initiated by irma at 14:10 UTC. Rolling back eu-central pool -> v3.1.8. ETA ~50s. Will run post-rollback synth-coverage extended probe.

sre-oncall: Created INC-2026-789: synth-coverage-euc. Capturing tokenizer traces, quant-profile dump, and kernel selection logs on affected hosts. Noting mixed host types on eu-central.

deploy-bot: Post-rollback probes (eu-central): synth-coverage=95%, embed-synth p95=48ms, 5xx=0.0%. eu-central status: PASS. Global quick smoke re-run: all probes OK. Canary overall: PASS (eu-central pinned to v3.1.8).

tanya: Good containment. Follow-ups: 1) reproduce synth-coverage gap on staging with the v3.2.0 quant profile, 2) add a short lint to catch tokenization-branch regressions in CI, 3) schedule a 30m extended canary with traffic ramp paused once fixes are ready. I'll note this in release notes: "isolated eu-central after synth-coverage regression; rolled back there; investigating tokenization edge-case."

leo: I'll add the temporary alert and the runbook step for mixed-host kernel mismatches. Leaving thread open for traces and final postmortem. :eyes:
